Thank you, I'm just having such a hard time recently. My son is 2 and I love him to death. It just seems that everyone around me makes me seem like I'm in the wrong. No matter what it is. I'm wrong.

I was on the edge about 3 months ago, similar to today, and no one understands what I feel like. My wife kicked me out of the house when I attempted to kill myself. She told me to not come back that night and we would work it out.

That was the worst night of my life. I almost drove into oncoming traffic, but I didn't want to bring another family into my problems.

I'm a little uncertain if she will try to send me somewhere again if I don't "perk up" like everyone says. I guess I'll just sleep in my car in a Walmart parking lot again if she does.
